# Meiko Trans Polska

Official website concept for Meiko Trans Polska, a B2B logistics operator based in Gliwice, Poland.

Core capabilities:
- Warehousing and value-added services
- Road and rail transport
- Air freight
- Ocean freight
- In-house customs services
- Supply-chain and warehouse consulting

Key verified facts:
- Meiko Group history begins in Nagoya in 1949
- Operations in Poland since 2005
- Two operating warehouses in Gliwice
- 21,980 m² of current operating warehouse space
- Four freight modes
- AEO and ISO 9001:2015 frameworks
